newsitem.title: FINLAND: OLVI SEES FULL-YR EARNINGS CLEARLY UP.
newsitem.headline: OLVI SEES FULL-YR EARNINGS CLEARLY UP.

text.p: Finnish beverages maker Olvi Oy said on Thursday it expected a clear improvement in full-year 1997 earnings.
"We expect the group's full-year earnings to improve clearly on the previous year," Olvi said in a statement with its January-April results.
Olvi's full-year 1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax was 7.6 million markka and net sales were 296 million markka.
It said a 2.5 percent hike in Olvi's beer wholesale prices starting May 21, and new product packagings would "enable a positive result development in end-year".
Olvi's new bottling line, which was taken into use in early May, put an end to the group's 10-year investment program.
"The group's production facilities enable efficient and competitive business operations and no additional investments are needed in the near-term," it said.
